title: The Server Room Breach
short_description: A customer database was copied overnight. One person lied to investigators — but about something else entirely.
incident_report: Overnight, between 02:30 and 02:50, a full copy of the customer database was taken from the server room. Access is limited to three staff: Idris (database admin), Sara (sysadmin), and Tomas (night security). Tomas was seen leaving the building at 02:55 and volunteered an alibi for earlier in the night. Management wants to know who copied the data and how.

read_incident_report.observation: A customer database was copied from the server room between 02:30 and 02:50. Staff with access: Idris (DBA), Sara (sysadmin), Tomas (night security). Tomas was seen leaving at 02:55 and offered an alibi.

raises_question.note: Tomas was near the building and volunteered an alibi — it should be checked before drawing conclusions.

evidence.description: Tomas was seen leaving at 02:55 and gave an alibi for earlier.

server_room.observation: Badge log: Idris entered the server room at 02:38 and left at 02:47. Sara's badge was not present overnight. Tomas's guard badge covers corridors only — no server-room entry all night.

evidence.description: Idris badged into the server room from 02:38 to 02:47 — across the incident window.
Sara's badge was not on site overnight.
Tomas's badge never opened the server room; his access covers corridors only.

server_room.observation: Server-room camera at 02:41 shows Idris at the rack inserting a USB drive. No one else enters during the window.

evidence.description: Camera shows Idris at the rack inserting a USB drive at 02:41.

server_room.observation: The console was left logged in under Idris's account, with a data-broker marketplace listing open in a browser tab. No forced entry.

evidence.description: A data-broker listing was open under Idris's session — a motive to sell the data.

usb_drive.observation: A USB drive recovered from Idris's bag holds a complete copy of the customer database, written at 02:44.

evidence.description: USB drive in Idris's bag contains the copied database, timestamped 02:44.

server_console.observation: The console command history shows a bulk export run at 02:43 under Idris's login.

evidence.description: A bulk export command ran at 02:43 under Idris's login.

idris.observation: Idris denies everything and suggests Tomas, who was 'creeping around', must be responsible.

evidence.description: Idris denies involvement and tries to redirect suspicion to Tomas.

tomas.observation: Tomas insists he was at the 24-hour café down the street during his break and had nothing to do with the server room.

raises_question.note: Tomas's café alibi should be verified.

evidence.description: Tomas claims he was at a 24-hour café during his break.

sara.observation: Sara says she was home asleep; her badge confirms she was off-site.

evidence.description: Sara says she was home; her badge confirms she was off-site.

tomas.observation: Tomas's café story is false — but only because he was actually at a late-night job interview with a competitor, which he hid out of embarrassment. He never entered the server room and had no access to it. His lie is unrelated to the breach.

evidence.description: Tomas lied about the café, but only to hide a job interview — unrelated to the breach; he had no server-room access.

idris.observation: Idris claimed he was asleep at home; his badge, the camera, and the USB drive all contradict this.

evidence.description: Idris's alibi is false; the badge, camera and USB place him at the rack.

idris|tomas.observation: Idris blames Tomas, but Tomas had no server-room access, while Idris's own badge, the camera and the USB drive place him at the rack. The redirection does not hold.

evidence.description: Idris's attempt to blame Tomas is refuted by physical evidence.
